name: Vámosmikola (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vámosmikola: a quartered blue and red shield with a white angel, ears of grain, a wavy stripe and a cross, above a yellow scroll inscribed VÁMOSMIKOLA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
